tasks.title: Verify the live Validation OS runtime
tasks.instruction: Inspect the current system and boot-runtime.json. Verify the automatic OS root workspace, persistent history, browser, native Codex sandbox and sign-in. Resolve supported runtime failures. Report missing evidence or credentials as blocked; do not infer a working OS from a successful image build.

tasks.title: Build the organized system tools
tasks.instruction: Continue implementing real devices, services, storage, files, networking, logs and maintenance tools from PROJECT_BRIEF.md. Preserve the approved artwork. Make one tested increment per turn; report complete only when the requested tool coverage is implemented and verified.

tasks.title: Verify Dev Kit hardware
tasks.instruction: Inventory actual Microsoft Windows Dev Kit 2023 hardware and verify each Microsoft/Qualcomm driver, network, display, audio and NPU. Distinguish VM results from physical device results. Do not install firmware, change partitions or claim hardware tests without measurements.

tasks.title: Develop and verify OS image recovery
tasks.instruction: Continue the private image build and recovery workflow. Kernel, driver and OS package updates require a validated offline image and a boot-tested recovery path. Keep Windows 11 and the existing EFI/recovery partitions intact. Stage changes for restart; never reboot automatically. Stop with specific missing prerequisites if this OS cannot run the image servicing tools.
